{{Short description|Software for automated theorem proving}}
{{primary|date=January 2014}}

'''IsaPlanner'''<ref>IsaPlanner 2: A Proof Planner in Isabelle. Lucas Dixon and Moa Johansson. System Description/Technical Report. 2007.</ref> is a [[Proof planning|proof planner]] for the interactive [[proof assistant]], [[Isabelle theorem prover|Isabelle]], originally developed by Lucas Dixon.<ref>A Proof Planning Framework for Isabelle.  Lucas Dixon.  PhD Thesis, University of Edinburgh.  2005.</ref>
